generatedFrom: BSC Scores.xlsx (Sheet1: Rd1/Rd2/Rd3/Rd4/Rd5/Rd6 round-only columns; Cumulative Total and Recap columns not used for ranking) + Competition Round 6 industry workbooks (CP1362xx_y_round_6_2032.xlsx: High Level Overview + Market Share Total)
rankingMetricLabel: Cumulative Total (Rd 1 + Rd 2 + Rd 3 + Rd 4 + Rd 5 + Rd 6)

priorRound.rankingMetricLabel: Cumulative as of Round 5 (Rd 1 + Rd 2 + Rd 3 + Rd 4 + Rd 5), without Practice Recap

methodNotes.cumulativeTotal: Rd1 + Rd2 + Rd3 + Rd4 + Rd5 + Rd6 round-only Balanced Scorecard scores from BSC Scores.xlsx. The Practice Recap is not included, and the spreadsheet Cumulative Total column (which includes Recap) is not used. Ranking is by this number.
methodNotes.roundOnlyBsc: Rd1, Rd2, Rd3, Rd4, Rd5 and Rd6 are each that round's Balanced Scorecard only (not running totals). bsc mirrors rd6Bsc; bscChange = rd6Bsc - rd5Bsc; cumulativeChange = rd6Bsc (points added this round).
methodNotes.prevCumulative: Rd1 + Rd2 + Rd3 + Rd4 + Rd5 (no Recap), calculated the same way as cumulativeTotal so rank arrows compare like with like.
methodNotes.rankChange: prevRank - rank on the cumulative leaderboard (positive means the team moved up since Round 5).
methodNotes.rd2RankChange: rd1Rank - rd2Rank using round-only BSC ranks.
methodNotes.rd3RankChange: rd2Rank - rd3Rank using round-only BSC ranks.
methodNotes.rd4RankChange: rd3Rank - rd4Rank using round-only BSC ranks.
methodNotes.rd5RankChange: rd4Rank - rd5Rank using round-only BSC ranks.
methodNotes.rd6RankChange: rd5Rank - rd6Rank using round-only BSC ranks (positive means a better Round 6 than Round 5 placing).
methodNotes.practiceRecap: recap is kept for reference only. It is not counted in any total or rank.
methodNotes.tieBreak: Cumulative ties: higher rd6Bsc, then team name A-Z, then industry code. prevCumulative ties: higher rd5Bsc, then team name. Round-only ranks: higher score, then the previous round score (rd2 uses rd1, rd3 uses rd2, rd4 uses rd3, rd5 uses rd4, rd6 uses rd5), then team name. Award ties: better cumulative rank wins and the tie is listed in awardNotes.
methodNotes.maxPoints: cumulativeMax is null: BSC Scores.xlsx shows only an overall max of 1000 (all 8 rounds plus Recap) and no per-round maximum, so a 6-round max cannot be derived from the sheet.
methodNotes.financials: Profit, sales and emergency loan are Round 6 results in $000s as shown in the Capsim workbooks. contributionMargin, roe, ros and marketShare are fractions. marketShare is the company Total actual market share.
methodNotes.highestROE: The ROE award counts only teams with a positive Round 6 profit, because a loss on negative equity can show as a large positive ROE in the Capsim workbook.
methodNotes.measurementChange: Totals cover Rounds 1–6 only. As in earlier rounds, the Practice Recap is not counted. Round 5 positions (prevRank) use Rd1 + Rd2 + Rd3 + Rd4 + Rd5 with no Recap, so the up/down arrows compare like with like.

bscNote: Official ranking uses Rd1 + Rd2 + Rd3 + Rd4 + Rd5 + Rd6 (no Practice Recap). Rd columns are per-round scores.

awardNotes.biggestClimber: Tie (2): Baldwin (CP136220_2), Andrews (CP136220_1); listed team has the better cumulative rank.

membersNote: Team members are first and last display names only. No emails, usernames, or student IDs.
